data.name: Invincible Stand
data.description: You can expend one use of mythic power as a swift action to make yourself nearly invincible for a short period of time. You gain DR 20/- for a number of rounds equal to your tier. If you choose to move or are moved by another creature during this time, this protection immediately ends.
